question: In Table 1 (the central composite design), what α-terpineol content was obtained in the run at 150 Pa, 30 °C and 2 mL/min?
rendered: In Table 1, the run at 150 Pa, 30 °C, and 2 mL/min corresponds to run number 14. The α-terpineol content obtained in this run is 66.66%.
